program.section_heading: (Program Code 060410, State Code 08536) — Broadcasting: Podcasting and Radio associate degree
outcomes: Students will write broadcast copy for audio and video, including news, sports, entertainment, promos, commercials, and public service announcements with emphasis on audio production.
Students will identify and apply theory and practice to create radio, podcasting, and television programs with emphasis on performance with emphasis on audio production.
Students will demonstrate producing, programming, and hosting skills within a studio, radio station, or television station structure with emphasis on audio production.

notes: The section's printed heading (program title and award line) falls before the excerpt; the text begins at '(Program Code 060410, State Code 08536)'. The description calls it 'The Broadcasting: Podcasting and Radio associate degree'; matched to Broadcasting: Radio A.A. by program code 060410 and state code 08536 (the certificate of the same name has state code 21888).
Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (BRDCSTG 001, 003, 010...); matched to closed-list codes without zeros (BRDCSTG 1, 3, 10...), so not marked as catalog additions.

Several catalog titles differ from the state file: BRDCSTG 011 'Social Media Audio Production' vs 'Digital Audio Editing and Production'; BRDCSTG 023 'Live Streaming Production' vs 'News, Sports, and Live Remote Broadcasting'; BRDCSTG 024 'Podcasting Production'; BRDCSTG 025 'Broadcast Media Writing'; BRDCSTG 026 'Broadcast Media Aesthetics'. Reviewer may confirm these are the same courses.
BRDCSTG 022-2 is printed with an asterisk, meaning it has a prerequisite or corequisite.
'Major Units: 32' recorded as total_units; 'Total Minimum Units: 60' recorded as degree_total. No GE pattern or GE units are printed in this section.
Careers taken from 'develop skills for working in radio, TV, and voice-over' in the degree description; reviewer may judge whether these count as career fields.
